![text](224,237,717,259) Select tuples of the loan relation where the branch name is "GMU"

![formula](361,261,536,285) $\sigma_{branch = 'GMU'} (Loan)$

![list](221,290,701,314)
- Find all tuples in which the amount of loan is more than \$12000.

![formula](275,312,443,337) $\sigma_{amount > 12000} (Loan)$

![list](218,346,833,372)
- Find those tuples pertaining to loans of more than \$ 12000 made by "GMU" branch.

![formula](270,370,750,398) $\sigma_{amount > 12000 \text{ and } branch = 'GMU'} (Loan)$

![list](218,401,564,423)
- List all loan numbers and the amount of loan.

![formula](275,424,474,448) $\pi_{loan\_N, amount} (Loan)$

![list](217,457,616,479)
- Find the names of all customers who live in "Fairfax".

![formula](286,479,597,507) $\pi_{name} (\sigma_{city = 'Fairfax'} (Customer))$

![list](216,514,836,535)
- Find the names of all bank customers who have either an account or a loan or both.

![formula](279,535,682,559) $\pi_{name} (Depositor) \cup \pi_{name} (Borrower)$

![list](216,568,817,588)
- Find the names of all customers of the bank who have an account but not a loan.

![formula](286,588,647,616) $\pi_{name} (Depositor) - \pi_{name} (Borrower)$

![list](216,625,745,644)
- Find the names of all customers who have both a loan and an account.

![formula](296,642,682,679) $\pi_{name} (Depositor) \cap \pi_{name} (Borrower)$
